hooks.name: honesty-review
hooks.description: Review in-character copy against honesty.md whenever a src/copy file is saved (uses credits each run).

action.prompt: Review the copy file just saved against .kiro/steering/honesty.md and the gravekeeper-voice steering. Flag any line that states a number, date, place or prediction not backed by public/data or a cited source, and propose a truthful rewrite in the same voice. If everything is fine, say so in one line.
